findings.title: New idempotency_key parameter not passed in webhook call
findings.body: The `record_payment` function now requires an `idempotency_key` parameter, but the call in `ledger/webhooks.py` line 18 still passes only `order_id` and `amount_cents`. This will raise a `TypeError` at runtime when the webhook invokes the updated function.

summary.problem: The idempotency_key parameter added to record_payment is not provided by the webhook handler, causing a runtime error.
summary.done_well: The idempotency pattern is correctly implemented in the new record_payment function with a lookup before creation.
